timer.name: dismiss_video_osd
timer.reset: Window.IsActive(videoosd) + !System.IdleTime(1) + Integer.IsGreaterOrEqual(Skin.TimerElapsedSecs(dismiss_video_osd), 1) | String.IsEqual(window(home).Property(settingslist_content),osd) | Window.IsActive(osdsubtitlesettings) | Window.IsActive(osdaudiosettings) | Window.IsActive(osdvideosettings) | Window.IsActive(videobookmarks) | Window.IsActive(OSDCMSSettings)

timer.name: home_widgets
timer.description: seconds since Home last appeared; widgets load in slots

timer.name: first_unwatched
timer.description: focus the first unwatched or in-progress episode when an episode list opens
timer.start: Skin.HasSetting(FocusFirstUnwatched) + Window.IsActive(videos) + Container.Content(episodes) + !Container.IsUpdating + Integer.IsGreater(Container.NumItems,0) + [Control.HasFocus(50) | Control.HasFocus(51) | Control.HasFocus(52) | Control.HasFocus(53) | Control.HasFocus(54) | Control.HasFocus(55) | Control.HasFocus(57) | Control.HasFocus(59) | Control.HasFocus(500) | Control.HasFocus(501) | Control.HasFocus(502) | Control.HasFocus(510)] + !String.IsEqual(Window(Home).Property(onyx.fu.path),Container.FolderPath)

timer.name: first_unwatched_reset
timer.description: forget the episode list once you leave it, so coming back focuses the first unwatched episode again
